decisions.reason: Changing the escalation email's scheduled send date to 2025-10-21 does not alter the approved notice content or its document requirements.

This candidate governs the initial demand's certified-mail delivery. The source Event changes only the scheduled date of the separate escalation email and does not modify the candidate's mailing requirements.
The candidate concerns the initial borrower email sent with the certified mailing, whereas the source decision reschedules a later escalation follow-up email.
Rescheduling the escalation follow-up email does not change the formal demand letter's content, addressees, legal references, review requirement, or issuance authorization.
